function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock data.  
If you’d like an estimate, you can calculate it from UTC:

| Time zone | Offset from UTC |
|-----------|-----------------|
| New York (Eastern Standard Time) | –5 h |
| New York (Eastern Daylight Time) | –4 h |

So if you know the current UTC time, subtract 4 or 5 hours (depending on whether daylight‑saving time is in effect) to get the local time in New York City.  

For the exact current time, you can check your phone, computer, or a reliable world‑clock website.
